definitions.gloss: to establish, to found, to set up
definitions.explanation: To create or establish something significant and lasting, such as a theory, a dynasty, or a new standard. Carries a sense of building something from the ground up with determination.
To achieve or set a notable record or accomplishment.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{理論|りろん}を{打|う}ち{立|た}てた。
{彼|かれ}は{独自|どくじ}のスタイルを{打|う}ち{立|た}てた{画家|がか}だ。
examples.english: He is a painter who established his own unique style.

examples.japanese: {長|なが}い{戦|たたか}いの{末|すえ}に、{新|あたら}しい{国家|こっか}を{打|う}ち{立|た}てた。
examples.english: After a long struggle, they founded a new nation.

examples.japanese: {世界新記録|せかいしんきろく}を{打|う}ち{立|た}てた。
examples.english: She set a new world record.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}{最多|さいた}の{得点記録|とくてんきろく}を{打|う}ち{立|た}てた。
examples.english: He set the highest scoring record this season.

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}にも{破|やぶ}れない{記録|きろく}を{打|う}ち{立|た}てることが{目標|もくひょう}だ。
examples.english: My goal is to set a record that no one can break.

notes:
{打|う}ち{立|た}てる conveys establishing something with force and determination. It is more emphatic than simple {立|た}てる and implies creating something significant or groundbreaking.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜を{打|う}ち{立|た}てる: to establish ~, to set ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記録|きろく}を{打|う}ち{立|た}てる: to set a record
- {理論|りろん}を{打|う}ち{立|た}てる: to establish a theory
- {王朝|おうちょう}を{打|う}ち{立|た}てる: to found a dynasty
- {基盤|きばん}を{打|う}ち{立|た}てる: to establish a foundation
- {地位|ちい}を{打|う}ち{立|た}てる: to establish a position

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {確立|かくりつ}する: to establish (more formal, abstract)
- {樹立|じゅりつ}する: to establish (formal; used for records, diplomatic relations)
